proposal.summary: An authenticated attacker can access sensitive information on the ArubaOS command line interface, potentially accessing data beyond their authorized privilege level.
proposal.cwe_quote: A vulnerability exists which allows an authenticated attacker to access sensitive information on the ArubaOS command line interface.

AV.quote: An authenticated attacker can access sensitive information on the ArubaOS command line interface

PR.quote: An authenticated attacker can access sensitive information on the ArubaOS command line interface

C.quote: Successful exploitation could allow access to data beyond what is authorized by the users existing privilege level.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request the full vendor advisory or technical report: include affected ArubaOS versions, exact CLI commands or privilege boundaries bypassed, attacker privileges required, and proof-of-concept details to refine severity and produce mitigation guidance.
